passage.text: On Friday afternoon, Ploy's laptop went missing from the university library.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn, ˈplɔɪz ˈlæptɑːp ˈwɛnt ˈmɪsɪŋ frəm ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈlaɪbrɛri.

passage.text: She had left it on a desk for ten minutes while she bought a coffee.
passage.reading: ʃiː hæd ˈlɛft ɪt ɑːn ə ˈdɛsk fər ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts waɪl ʃiː ˈbɔːt ə ˈkɔːfi.

passage.text: When she came back, it had disappeared.
passage.reading: wɛn ʃiː ˈkeɪm ˈbæk, ɪt hæd ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd.

passage.text: Nam decided to be a detective.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə bi ə dɪˈtɛktɪv.

passage.text: Three students had been near Ploy's desk: Top, Mint and Joe.
passage.reading: ˈθriː ˈstuːdənts hæd bɪn ˈnɪr ˈplɔɪz ˈdɛsk: ˈtɑːp, ˈmɪnt ənd ˈdʒoʊ.

passage.text: Top said that he had been in the computer lab all afternoon.
passage.reading: ˈtɑːp ˈsɛd ðæt hiː hæd bɪn ɪn ðə kəmˈpjuːtər ˌlæb ˈɔːl ˌæftərˈnuːn.

passage.text: Mint said that she had gone home early, and Joe said that he had slept in the library.
passage.reading: ˈmɪnt ˈsɛd ðæt ʃiː hæd ˈɡɔːn ˈhoʊm ˈɜːrli, ənd ˈdʒoʊ ˈsɛd ðæt hiː hæd ˈslɛpt ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri.

passage.text: Nam checked the CCTV with the library guard.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈtʃɛkt ðə ˌsiː siː tiː ˈviː wɪð ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ˈɡɑːrd.

passage.text: The video showed that Top had not been in the computer lab.
passage.reading: ðə ˈvɪdioʊ ˈʃoʊd ðæt ˈtɑːp hæd ˈnɑːt bɪn ɪn ðə kəmˈpjuːtər ˌlæb.

passage.text: "OK, I lied," Top said. "I skipped class to play video games at the café. But I'm innocent!"
passage.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ ˈlaɪd, ˈtɑːp ˈsɛd. aɪ ˈskɪpt ˈklæs tə ˈpleɪ ˈvɪdioʊ ˌɡeɪmz ət ðə kæˈfeɪ. bʌt aɪm ˈɪnəsənt!

passage.text: The video also showed Joe. He was not sleeping. He was leaving the library with Ploy's laptop bag!
passage.reading: ðə ˈvɪdioʊ ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈʃoʊd ˈdʒoʊ. hiː wʌz ˈnɑːt ˈsliːpɪŋ. hiː wʌz ˈliːvɪŋ ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri wɪð ˈplɔɪz ˈlæptɑːp ˈbæɡ!

passage.text: When Nam showed him the video, Joe looked guilty.
passage.reading: wɛn ˈnɑːm ˈʃoʊd hɪm ðə ˈvɪdioʊ, ˈdʒoʊ ˈlʊkt ˈɡɪlti.

passage.text: Finally, he confessed and told the truth: he had hidden the laptop in his locker because he needed money.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪnəli, hiː kənˈfɛst ənd ˈtoʊld ðə ˈtruːθ: hiː hæd ˈhɪdən ðə ˈlæptɑːp ɪn hɪz ˈlɑːkər bɪˈkɔːz hiː ˈniːdɪd ˈmʌni.

passage.text: Ploy got her laptop back, and Nam got a new nickname: "Detective Nam."
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ ˈɡɑːt hɜːr ˈlæptɑːp ˈbæk, ənd ˈnɑːm ˈɡɑːt ə ˈnuː ˈnɪkneɪm: dɪˈtɛktɪv ˈnɑːm.
